note: Four corrections: Diyala valley restored to the Ur III keyframe (-2100); the Siut speckle cut from the Theban shape (keyframe override for -2061..-2056, loss event for -2055..-2034 because the Middle Kingdom's founding region re-adds it); the Siut valley cells filled when Egypt is reunited (-2033).

region.text: the Nile valley at Siut (the Asyut governorate and the land within 30 km of Siut) and Abydos inside the reunited kingdom's shape, which no state held in -2055..-2034; reviewer: Asyut 30 km added so the Siut cells that events/1 and keyframe_overrides/1 empty (27.1 N 31.1 E, 27.2 N 31.4 E) and 27.1 N 30.9 E are not left nobody's inside the kingdom's outline in -2033..-2001

events.note: c. 2033 BC: Siut, the old buffer province, falls to the reunited kingdom. Mentuhotep II 'would eventually defeat the Heracleopolitan kings around 2033 BC and unify the country'; 'The Siut province acted as a buffer state between the northern and southern rulers', so it lay in neither kingdom's shape before the reunification.

region.text: the cells at Siut itself (27.1 N 31.1 E and 27.2 N 31.4 E) that the Theban shape (Cliopatria's Upper Egypt minus the Asyut governorate) kept outside the governorate; the Middle Kingdom's founding region re-adds them, so they are cut here until the reunification of 2033

events.note: c. 2055 BC: the Theban border stops short of Siut, 'a buffer state between the northern and southern rulers'; Intef III had 'completed the conquest of Abydos, moving into Middle Egypt against the Heracleopolitan kings'.

correction.text: the Ur III realm of Sumer and Akkad with Susiana (Cliopatria's outline, labelled Gutian) plus the Diyala valley (Eshnunna, Tutub, Zimudar), which Ur-Nammu took back from Puzur-Inshushinak; the small circle fills the one-cell gap at 33.1 N 45.2 E between the outline and the Diyala

keyframe_overrides.why: Ur-Nammu 'reconquered the northern territories that had been occupied by Puzur-Inshushinak', which Ur-Nammu's inscription lists as 'the lands of Esnuna, Tutub, Zimudar, and Akkade' (Kutik-Inshushinak page); the Ur III page has his 'domination in the northeast direction towards Diyala' and later 'the Diyala Valley, where garrisons were established' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Third_Dynasty_of_Ur). Cliopatria's shape stops at 33.4 N and drops the Diyala, so the snap left 77 Diyala cells (Eshnunna's land) nobody's from -2100 to -2050, against the dossier's own ledger line (gain Akkad and Diyala, -2100) and its keyframe text.

correction.text: Thebes after the conquest of Nekhen and Abydos: Elephantine north to Abydos, short of Siut, which 'acted as a buffer state'

keyframe_overrides.why: The dossier's shape is Cliopatria's Upper Egypt minus the Asyut governorate, but two cells at Siut itself (27.2 N 31.4 E and 27.1 N 31.1 E) lie outside the governorate's cells and stayed as a detached speckle; the page has Intef III 'moving into Middle Egypt' only after Abydos and says 'The Siut province acted as a buffer state between the northern and southern rulers'.
